paper.title_en: The Mass-Angular Momentum Inequality for Multiple Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: This is the second in a series of two papers to address the conjectured mass-angular momentum inequality for multiple black holes. Our main result has two parts. In the first part, it is shown that either there is a counterexample to black hole uniqueness, in the form of a regular axisymmetric stationary vacuum spacetime with an asymptotically flat end and multiple degenerate horizons which is `ADM minimizing', or the following statement holds. Complete, simply connected, maximal initial data sets for the Einstein equations with multiple ends that are either asymptotically flat or asymptotically cylindrical, admit an ADM mass lower bound given by the square root of total angular momentum, under the assumption of nonnegative energy density and axisymmetry. Moreover, equality is achieved in this mass lower bound only for a constant time slice of an extreme Kerr spacetime. Consequently, due to the nonexistence of stationary vacuum two-black hole configurations, the mass-angular momentum conjecture is verified for two black holes. In the second part, the mass-angular momentum inequality is established unconditionally, but with a suboptimal constant of $\frac{1}{2}$. The proof is based on a novel flow of singular harmonic maps with hyperbolic plane target, under which the renormalized harmonic map energy is monotonically nonincreasing. Relevant properties of the flow are achieved through a refined asymptotic analysis of solutions to the harmonic map equations and their linearization. Additionally, we establish and utilize the Penrose inequality for manifolds with asymptotically cylindrical ends.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文涉及广义相对论中的质量-角动量不等式，这是基础物理研究，与黑洞热力学相关，理论深度高。方法严谨，创新性强。
decision.title_zh: 多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式
decision.abstract_zh: 这是两篇系列论文中的第二篇，旨在解决多黑洞的质量-角动量不等式猜想。我们的主要结果分为两部分。在第一部分中，证明了要么存在黑洞唯一性的反例，形式为具有渐近平坦端和多个退化视界的正则轴对称稳态真空时空，并且该时空是“ADM最小化”的；要么以下陈述成立。对于爱因斯坦方程的完整、单连通、极大初始数据集，具有多个端，且这些端要么渐近平坦要么渐近圆柱形，在非负能量密度和轴对称性的假设下，ADM质量存在由总角动量的平方根给出的下界。此外，该质量下界仅在极端Kerr时空的恒定时间切片上达到等号。因此，由于不存在稳态真空双黑洞构型，质量-角动量猜想对双黑洞情况得到验证。在第二部分中，质量-角动量不等式被无条件建立，但常数不最优，为$\frac{1}{2}$。证明基于一种新的具有双曲平面目标的奇异调和映射流，在该流下，重整化调和映射能量单调不减。流的相关性质通过对调和映射方程及其线性化解的精细渐近分析实现。此外，我们建立并利用了具有渐近圆柱形端的流形上的彭罗斯不等式。
